writes.bodyFrom.callTooBig: One call reads {most} bytes of files at the most, all together ({bytes})
writes.bodyFrom.folderGone: The working directory's folder {folder} is not there
writes.bodyFrom.missing: There is no file at the path "{path}" of {key}
writes.bodyFrom.noBody: {at} has no body. Write bodyFrom on a text row (rows[].bodyFrom, or a target that is a row's path) or on a stackdoc's version
writes.bodyFrom.notFile: The path "{path}" of {key} is not a file
writes.bodyFrom.notUtf8: The path "{path}" of {key} is not UTF-8 text
writes.bodyFrom.outside: The path "{path}" of {key} leads outside the working directory (.., a path starting with / or ~, and a link pointing outside are not read)
writes.bodyFrom.tooLong: The path "{path}" of {key} is over the body's limit of {most} characters ({chars})
writes.bodyFrom.unbound: The working directory "{name}" has no folder in this place (choose one in the app's working directories)
writes.bodyFrom.withBody: bodyFrom cannot be written with body (give the body one way or the other)
writes.create.bodyOnly: {name} is a {kind} and has no named rows inside (write the text in body; to write with items and rows, use a kind: formatdoc card)
writes.create.containerUnmade: The container {container} could not be made, so {path} inside it is not made (fix the container's error)
writes.create.instanceValue: {name} is data (instance), and the values inside it are not made (only an array's element is, by card_create on the element's path with value {"value": …, "position": …}). Write values in data, or to the value's path ({path}) with card_update's value {"value": …}
writes.create.sectionNeeded: Write target with its section (for example: Schemas:User. The sections are {sections})
writes.delete.boardReached: {count} cards on the board ({paths}) had a line or a path in their body to this card. They are now broken and show in the board's inspection
writes.delete.valueKey: card_delete's value cannot take {key}. It can take only rev (the card's rev when it was read)
writes.delete.valueKeyAt: card_delete's value for {path} cannot take {key}. It can take only rev (the card's rev when it was read)
writes.inside.noRows: {name} is a {kind} and has no named rows inside
writes.inside.ownKind: {path} is a place inside {name} ({kind}) and cannot be a target. Write fields and rows in the card's value (for example: {"target": "{full}", "value": {"{row}": …}})
writes.update.inContainer: {path} is inside a container. To change the container, use in in value (the container's path); to take it out of the container, use in: null
writes.update.nothing: There is nothing to change (give what to change in value)
writes.update.placesNotMap: places is for the boxes of a goal's contents map ({path} is a {kind}. The boxes of a section's diagram are section_update's places)
